    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

## **Entirely Kids Pediatrics**

Entirely Kids Pediatrics is a Frisco Pediatric practice that is conveniently located at Baylor
Medical Center of Frisco, and we are committed to providing efficient yet thorough, comprehensive
care to children from birth to 18 years of age. Our goal is to provide a comfortable, trusting
environment for both parents and children for all aspects of the child’s primary medical care.
Children are the future of our world, and we want to ensure that they grow up healthy and happy!

Our Pediatrician specializes in helping children with ADHD. We are happy to schedule an appointment
with you to discuss your child and the challenges you are facing.

We strive to be the best pediatrician’s office in Frisco. As a result, we work to give your newborn
and growing children the best pediatric care available, coupled with attentive & caring staff. We
feature a female doctor for parents who prefer to have their daughters visit with a female
pediatrician.
Call us today at **[(469) 425-3600][26]**.

[**Contact Us**][27]

### Newborn Pediatric Care

Selecting the right Frisco pediatrician for your [newborn][28] before you give birth can help
prevent you from being overwhelmed once you bring your baby home from the hospital.

[New Baby Pediatric Care][29]

### Same Day Appointments

We offer same day appointments for sick children at our pediatrician’s office and we keep a few
spots open for same day well visits and immunizations. Call us today.

[Covid-19 Testing][30] & [Telemedicine][31]

### Well Child Visits

We offer appointments for well-child visits and immunizations. Even if your child is healthy, a
well-child visit is a good time to focus on your child’s wellness. Preventative care and exams are
an important part of keeping your child healthy.

[Prenatal pediatric consultations in Frisco TX with Dr. Danielle Leung for expectant parents]

## Meet the Doctors

Dr. Danielle Leung is a **board-certified pediatrician who is a native of Texas**. She received her
undergraduate education at Austin College in Sherman, then completed her medical studies at **UT
Southwestern Medical Center** in Dallas. Her residency training was completed at Cardinal Glennon
Children’s Hospital in St. Louis. Since completing her studies and training, she has worked in
private practice and pediatric urgent care. Recently, she decided to return to the private medical
practice and establish Entirely Kids Pediatrics in Frisco, TX. She is proficient in medical Spanish,
Cantonese and Mandarin Chinese. Dr. Leung currently lives with her husband and two sons. She enjoys
traveling, cooking, baking, yoga, and reading in her spare time.

[Karen Cheng]

Dr. Karen Cheng is a ***board certified general pediatrician from the DFW area***. She attended the
University of Texas at Dallas for her undergraduate studies and then received her osteopathic
medical degree from **Kansas City University**. Dr. Cheng went on to complete her pediatric
residency at Oklahoma Children’s Hospital in Oklahoma City. She practiced as a general pediatrician
in Oklahoma City before recently moving back to Texas with hopes to serve the DFW community in which
she grew up. Dr. Cheng speaks English and Vietnamese. In her spare time, Dr. Cheng enjoys spending
time with her husband, son, and dog by exploring new cuisines, hiking near and far, and traveling to
visit different national parks.

## FAQs

#### Do you take walk-in visits?

No, we currently DO NOT take walk-ins. However, we do our very best to give same-day visits
depending on the physicians schedule that day but it must be made in advanced. All visits must be
scheduled IN ADVANCE!

If your child has an urgent matter that requires immediate attention, we would recommend you go to
the nearest

👉 [Children's Hospital of Orange County Emergency Room][96]

👉 [Pomona Valley Medical Center Emergency Room][97]

#### I have a school form (ie. medicines, allergies, sports physical, annual physical) to be
#### completed. How can I get that done?

Drop off the form to one of our staff members during normal office hours and we will have it
completed it for you WITHIN 3-5 business day. Most forms will require a form fee of $35 for our
administrative time. If you need it rushed, there is a rush fee of $10.

You can either pick it up in person or the completed form can be e-mailed to you.

#### What is the best way to schedule an appointment with your office?

You can schedule an appointment by

1) Requesting an appointment through your [**patient portal**][98]

2) Submitting a request online [**HERE**][99]

3) Calling our office during regular [**business hours**][100]

#### Is your office accepting new patients?

Yes, we are accepting new patients. Please complete the new patient registration form
[**HERE**][101] and one of our staff will check insurance eligibility before contacting you back to
schedule an appointment.

## FAQs

#### Do you take walk-in visits?

No, we currently DO NOT take walk-ins. However, we do our very best to give same-day visits
depending on the physicians schedule that day but it must be made in advanced. All visits must be
scheduled IN ADVANCE!

If your child has an urgent matter that requires immediate attention, we would recommend you go to
the nearest

👉 [Children's Hospital of Orange County Emergency Room][96]

👉 [Pomona Valley Medical Center Emergency Room][97]

#### I have a school form (ie. medicines, allergies, sports physical, annual physical) to be
#### completed. How can I get that done?

Drop off the form to one of our staff members during normal office hours and we will have it
completed it for you WITHIN 3-5 business day. Most forms will require a form fee of $35 for our
administrative time. If you need it rushed, there is a rush fee of $10.

You can either pick it up in person or the completed form can be e-mailed to you.

#### What is the best way to schedule an appointment with your office?

You can schedule an appointment by

1) Requesting an appointment through your [**patient portal**][98]

2) Submitting a request online [**HERE**][99]

3) Calling our office during regular [**business hours**][100]

#### Is your office accepting new patients?

Yes, we are accepting new patients. Please complete the new patient registration form
[**HERE**][101] and one of our staff will check insurance eligibility before contacting you back to
schedule an appointment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

You are at the heart of what we do, and how we do it. We make it our mission to understand what
really matters to you, what you value the most. This helps us empower you with the tools, expertise
and support that are vital to what you do, no matter where you are in the world.

#### Why choose Keeler?

Your first purchase of ophthalmic instruments is important to you. You want to be confident that you
are purchasing the highest quality optical instruments that will last you for many, many years.
After all, your tools will ensure your own clinical performance is the best it can possibly be. That
can only be achieved with the highest quality optics.

 

##### You want to purchase from a company that you know you can trust

Keeler has been manufacturing precision optical instruments for almost a century. Today, the Keeler
name is synonymous throughout the world with the very highest quality and most reliable optical
equipment.

May 05, 2026
Ophthalmoscopes, Partner education, Students,

When it comes to diagnosing eye conditions, your handheld direct ophthalmoscope plays an important
role in any examination. And key to getting a consistently good view is its bulb, which provides the
necessary illumination for examining your patients’ eyes.

We’ve come a long way since candle-light was used for such instruments, and in this blog, we explore
the different types of ophthalmoscope bulbs available; their characteristics and differences, how to
maintain them effectively, and why we still make ours by hand.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is

[devices-osirix]

With high performance and an intuitive interactive user interface, OsiriX is the most widely used
DICOM viewer in the world. It is the result of more than 20 years of research and development in
digital imaging. It fully supports the DICOM standard for an easy integration in your workflow
environment and an open platform for development of processing tools. It offers advanced
post-processing techniques in 2D and 3D, exclusive innovative technique for 3D and 4D navigation and
a complete integration with any PACS. OsiriX supports 64-bit computing and multithreading for the
best performances on the most modern processors. OsiriX MD, the commercial version, is certified for
medical use (FDA cleared and CE II labeled).

[devices-osirix]

With high performance and an intuitive interactive user interface, OsiriX is the most widely used
DICOM viewer in the world. It is the result of more than 20 years of research and development in
digital imaging. It fully supports the DICOM standard for an easy integration in your workflow
environment and an open platform for development of processing tools. It offers advanced
post-processing techniques in 2D and 3D, exclusive innovative technique for 3D and 4D navigation and
a complete integration with any PACS. OsiriX supports 64-bit computing and multithreading for the
best performances on the most modern processors. OsiriX MD, the commercial version, is certified for
medical use (FDA cleared and CE II labeled).

# Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation 

[RI Lions Sight Foundation logo]
[spot camera used for vision screening]

## [ABOUT US][16]

## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation (RILSF) provides assistance to visually impaired persons 
## in our Rhode Island communities.
## The RILSF is composed of representatives from Lions clubs around Rhode Island. The assistance we
## provide can be financial, material, social and developmental.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation was founded in 1961 as a charitable arm of the Lions
## Clubs International, District 42.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit organization.

## [RECENT EVENTS][34]

[2026_RI_VIPFishingTornament.JPG]

### [2026  19th Annual RI VIP Fishing Tournament][35]

The 19th RI VIP Fishing Tournament was held on June 26th and was very successful. The weather was
good and the seas calm .

[group shot.jfif]

### [Camp Mauchatea 2026  Winter  Camp][36]

Camp Mauchatea Winter Camp was a great  success! Campers stayed at the Great Wolf Lodge in
Mashantucket, CT, and went swimming, and on ropes courses and  water slides, played golf, and
snooker as well as going in the hot tub plus eating great food. 

[RILSF vision screeners at a RI school]

### [SCHOOL YEAR 2025-2026  VISION SCREENING][37]

The RILSF and local RI Lions clubs helped with vision pre-screening of preschool, elementary, middle
(7th grade),  and high school students (9th grade) through out RI. 

Over 37,661 students at  180 schools in RI were screened  by the RI Lions Sight Foundation and local
RI Lions clubs in the 2025-2026  school year.  

### [2025  2nd Annual Golf Tournament][38]

The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation held its 2nd Annual VIP Golf Tournament on October 25, 2025,
at Top Golf in Cranston, RI. VIPS and sighted golfers could  have breakfast, play golf, and
participate in the raffle held.

[Packing eye glasses to be sent to Lions Eyeglass Recycling Center]

### [Annual Eye Glass Collection Event][39]

 On May 16, 2024, over 30 Lions from various Rhode Island Lions Cubs, in addition to a North
Smithfield High School student, packed about  16,000 pairs of eyeglasses to be sent to the New
Jersey Lions Eye Glass Recycling Center. There the eyeglass lens powers are measured and then the
eyeglasses are catalogued by lens power. They can be shipped to missions that provide eyecare for
communities around the world that do not have good eye care. 
Thank you to the Sunnyside Restaurant for letting the RILSF use their space for this event and their
help with the shipping. 
 

## DONATE

The RI Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit dedicated to helping visually impaired people
living in RI

The RI Lions Sight Foundation accepts donations to support our programs for helping visually
impaired persons in Rhode Island. Funds collected support the camps we run for visually impaired
children as well as providing eye exams and glasses to those who need financial help, recreational
programs like the fishing tournament and rowing program,  and helping perform vision screening in RI
schools.

Donations by check can be sent to

## [ABOUT US][16]

## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation (RILSF) provides assistance to visually impaired persons 
## in our Rhode Island communities.
## The RILSF is composed of representatives from Lions clubs around Rhode Island. The assistance we
## provide can be financial, material, social and developmental.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation was founded in 1961 as a charitable arm of the Lions
## Clubs International, District 42.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit organization.

## [RILSF PROGRAMS][17]

## [RECENT EVENTS][34]

[2026_RI_VIPFishingTornament.JPG]

### [2026  19th Annual RI VIP Fishing Tournament][35]

The 19th RI VIP Fishing Tournament was held on June 26th and was very successful. The weather was
good and the seas calm .

[group shot.jfif]

### [Camp Mauchatea 2026  Winter  Camp][36]

Camp Mauchatea Winter Camp was a great  success! Campers stayed at the Great Wolf Lodge in
Mashantucket, CT, and went swimming, and on ropes courses and  water slides, played golf, and
snooker as well as going in the hot tub plus eating great food. 

[RILSF vision screeners at a RI school]

### [SCHOOL YEAR 2025-2026  VISION SCREENING][37]

The RILSF and local RI Lions clubs helped with vision pre-screening of preschool, elementary, middle
(7th grade),  and high school students (9th grade) through out RI. 

Over 37,661 students at  180 schools in RI were screened  by the RI Lions Sight Foundation and local
RI Lions clubs in the 2025-2026  school year.  

### [2025  2nd Annual Golf Tournament][38]

The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation held its 2nd Annual VIP Golf Tournament on October 25, 2025,
at Top Golf in Cranston, RI. VIPS and sighted golfers could  have breakfast, play golf, and
participate in the raffle held.

[Packing eye glasses to be sent to Lions Eyeglass Recycling Center]

### [Annual Eye Glass Collection Event][39]

 On May 16, 2024, over 30 Lions from various Rhode Island Lions Cubs, in addition to a North
Smithfield High School student, packed about  16,000 pairs of eyeglasses to be sent to the New
Jersey Lions Eye Glass Recycling Center. There the eyeglass lens powers are measured and then the
eyeglasses are catalogued by lens power. They can be shipped to missions that provide eyecare for
communities around the world that do not have good eye care. 
Thank you to the Sunnyside Restaurant for letting the RILSF use their space for this event and their
help with the shipping. 
 

## DONATE

The RI Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit dedicated to helping visually impaired people
living in RI

The RI Lions Sight Foundation accepts donations to support our programs for helping visually
impaired persons in Rhode Island. Funds collected support the camps we run for visually impaired
children as well as providing eye exams and glasses to those who need financial help, recreational
programs like the fishing tournament and rowing program,  and helping perform vision screening in RI
schools.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

### Actionable Strategies

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through

  **The National Telehealth Technology Assessment Resource Center** aims to create better-informed
consumers of telehealth technology. By offering a variety of services in the area of technology
assessment, TTAC (pronounced “tea-tac”) aims to become the place for answers to questions about
selecting appropriate technologies for your telehealth program. [More information >][20]

#### TTAC UPDATES

#### FEATURED ITEMS

**[Meet the Team][27]**
**[Electronic Stethoscope Toolkit][28]**

Electronic stethoscopes enhance traditional auscultation by amplifying body sounds and converting
them into digital signals that can be heard locally, stored for later review, or transmitted live
during telehealth visits. This makes them especially valuable in remote care, where clinicians can
assess heart, lung, and other sounds in real time or asynchronously.

**[Clinician’s Guide to Video Platforms][29]**

Why This Guide Matters

While audio-only visits expanded access during the COVID-19 public health emergency, video remains
the dominant format for telehealth encounters nationwide. Video enables visual assessment, nonverbal
communication, and stronger clinical context—elements that are essential for quality care but highly
sensitive to technology performance.

**[Electronic Stethoscope Toolkit][28]**

Electronic stethoscopes enhance traditional auscultation by amplifying body sounds and converting
them into digital signals that can be heard locally, stored for later review, or transmitted live
during telehealth visits. This makes them especially valuable in remote care, where clinicians can
assess heart, lung, and other sounds in real time or asynchronously.

**[Clinician’s Guide to Video Platforms][29]**

Why This Guide Matters

While audio-only visits expanded access during the COVID-19 public health emergency, video remains
the dominant format for telehealth encounters nationwide. Video enables visual assessment, nonverbal
communication, and stronger clinical context—elements that are essential for quality care but highly
sensitive to technology performance.

## Flexible Solutions For Your Practice

Our fine-precision instruments consist of modular systems, which can be updated to keep pace with
the latest technological developments. The products are in a process of constant change through
intensive research work, and exchange with customers, scientists, and experts.

"A Company with an Eye for Good Service" is our company motto here at Veatch Instruments and
everyone in our family truly believes in that. You are invited and welcome to join our family
online, at any of the trade shows we attend or in person at our office in Tempe, AZ.

## Testimonials

Veatch has been integral in improving our office flow & efficiency.

*"Since going to a completely automated office, each individual doctor has been able to see
approximately six additional patients per day in the same time period and the bottom line has
improved accordingly."*

- Steven Richlin, Beverly Hills, CA

Allows for better exam, more accurate & in a short period of time, resulting in 2-4 additional
patients/day.

*"The bottom line is that the system allows me to do a beter exam, more accurately and in a shorter
period of time which adds 2-4 patients per day. The wow factor alone increases patient referrals."*

the latest technological developments. The products are in a process of constant change through
intensive research work, and exchange with customers, scientists, and experts.

"A Company with an Eye for Good Service" is our company motto here at Veatch Instruments and
everyone in our family truly believes in that. You are invited and welcome to join our family
online, at any of the trade shows we attend or in person at our office in Tempe, AZ.

## WORLD CLASS BICYCLE COMPONENTS FOR ROAD CYCLING AND MOUNTAIN BIKING

We don’t simply sponsor world-class teams and athletes, we work extremely closely with them and use
their expertise and feedback to help us develop the next range of products. This, combined with our
passionate commitment to innovative design, research and development, materials and manufacturing
processes, ensures we deliver technically superior components that deliver the ultimate performance
that riders demand, and all at competitive prices.

[ prev ][75] [ next ][76]

#### FOCUS ON

## KFX SIC INTEGRATED HANDLEBAR

[KFX SIC INTEGRATED HANDLEBAR]

The KFX SIC (Stable Integrated Cockpit) 1-piece handlebar is the complete race ready cockpit.  By
integrating the bar and the stem, FSA has eliminated unnecessary hardware and components. The result
is a lighter weight system with increased strength in a visually stunning package. ICR compatible,
allows for up to 5 cables or hoses to run internally resulting in a clean, Integrated Cable Routing
solution for frame and bicycle brands.

[ MORE INFO ][77]

#### FOCUS ON

## NS VAS STEM

[NS VAS STEM]

FSA's new Vibration Absorbing Stem for Gravel application is the first of its kind.  Featuring
significant vibration damping via 360 degree handlebar isolation. In turn, reducing forces and
impacts to the rider's hands and arms.  The result being less arm pump and hand fatigue for a better
ride and shorter recovery.

[ MORE INFO ][78]

#### FOCUS ON

## K-FORCE TEAM EDITION CRANKSET

[K-FORCE TEAM EDITION CRANKSET]

"When only the best will do” is the reason FSA developed the K-Force Light series. Featuring the
latest advancements in carbon composite and metal alloy technology coupled with state-of-the-art
manufacturing processes, K-Force Light components showcase the epitome of FSA’s dedication to
advancements in state-of-the-art product design, engineering and manufacturing.

[ MORE INFO ][79]

Rahul Shah, Co-Founder & Director

Rahul brings more than 20 years of industry experience, out of which, he has spent more than 17
years in the Executive Search industry. After his MBA, he worked for close to 3 years in the Steel
Industry with Usha Martin and then moved to the Executive Search industry with ABC Consultants. He
spent more than 9 years with ABC Consultants and was last designated as an Executive Director
responsible for running the Bangalore office, the 3rd largest office by revenues.

As Co-Founder of WalkWater, he personally leads Senior Searches across sectors, with a sectoral
specialisation in the Consumer, Pharma and Industrial sectors. In this exciting career, he has had
the opportunity of working as a Trusted Talent Advisor with senior candidates and with a variety of
clients across sectors – large Indian Conglomerates, Blue Chip MNCs, Emerging Companies and
Mid-sized firms.

He is an Instrumentation Engineer from Bangalore University and has completed his MBA from XIM,
Bhubaneswar. He is certified in Personal Profile Analysis from Thomas International.

Outside work, he is a biker and loves to travel and watch movies.

×
Kunal Girap, Co-Founder & Director

With over two decades of experience, Kunal leads senior searches across multiple sectors and is a
trusted advisor to global business leaders in the Industry. He leads the Automotive, Aerospace &
Defense, Process & Infrastructure practices for the firm with teams spread across India & US. Kunal
is also architecting WalkWater’s digital journey and is passionate about technology and its impact
on the executive search process.

He has multifaceted background in Project Management, Industrial Sales & Marketing, Manufacturing
and Consulting that enables him to relate with candidates and clients across diverse sectors. Kunal
worked with Tyco International, Hindalco and ABC Consultants before Co-founding WalkWater.

A graduate in Mechanical Engineering and Executive Management Program from IIM Bangalore, Kunal is a
sports & fitness enthusiast and plays active club cricket in Mumbai. Kunal is a Rotarian and quite
passionate about giving it back to the society through the Rotary platform.

×
Harold D’Souza, Co-Founder & Director

Harold has worked in the Executive Search industry since 1998 , when the industry was still
developing into an important part of the corporate world. He has been part of the evolution of the
search industry and over the last two decades has contributed to its current stature and
positioning.

Before co-founding WalkWater, he was responsible for building the Technology Industry Practice in
India for Accord Group India and DHR International. Earlier experiences has been with E&Y and PSS.
His key expertise is building revenue and profit generating search businesses from scratch; and
developing long standing relationships with leaders, across industry sectors.

A special area of focus is Indian Business Houses and entrepreneur driven companies. Harold also
leads CEO and leadership searches, especially in Technology and related sectors. He also works
closely with many start-ups and founders.

Harold is a firm believer in the power of instinct in personal and professional life. He is also an
avid foodie, loves to cook and travel; and a keen squash player. He is also a non-fiction book lover
and owns a huge collection of books at his home in Bangalore.

×
Ashutosh Khanna, Co-Founder & Director

Ashu has more than 20 years of experience out of which he has spent 18+ years in the Executive
Search industry. Before co-founding WalkWater, Ashu led the Technology Practice at Korn/Ferry
FutureStep. During his career in the industry, he has successfully partnered with numerous
organisations on building their leadership team across India, US, Europe and South East Asia. He has
had the privilege to work with well-known Leaders of large firms (MNC/ Indian) as well as Founders
of Startup organizations across Technology and Consumer sectors.

With PGD in International Business from Symbiosis, Mechanical Engineering from Bangalore University
and Diploma in Consumer Protection Laws, Ashu is also certified in Competency based interviewing
from SHL and Right Management, Personality Profiling from Thomas International and Coaching Skills
by Results Coaching, Australia.

Besides work, he loves to read, play, travel and do long distance running.

×

# WalkWater Talent Advisors, one of the top executive search firms in India

###### *“Leadership is the capacity to translate vision into reality.”*

In 2011, a team of Executive Search industry leaders realized their collective vision – to rethink
hiring practices for an era of unprecedented change. Globalisation, growing impact of technology and
the rise of start-ups are now changing traditional notions of jobs, career stability, growth and
opportunity; and most importantly changing the notions of leadership and expectations from corporate
leaders. In this new era of leadership, WalkWater Talent Advisors has emerged as one of India’s
fastest growing and innovative leadership search and talent advisory firms. The WalkWater team
brings a unique mix of strengths – Intensive Client Partnering, Deep Domain Knowledge and Global
Coverage; this coupled with a start-up drive to excel, and a constant focus on values, provides an
unparalleled experience to our clients.

Rahul Shah, Co-Founder & Director

Rahul brings more than 20 years of industry experience, out of which, he has spent more than 17
years in the Executive Search industry. After his MBA, he worked for close to 3 years in the Steel
Industry with Usha Martin and then moved to the Executive Search industry with ABC Consultants. He
spent more than 9 years with ABC Consultants and was last designated as an Executive Director
responsible for running the Bangalore office, the 3rd largest office by revenues.

As Co-Founder of WalkWater, he personally leads Senior Searches across sectors, with a sectoral
specialisation in the Consumer, Pharma and Industrial sectors. In this exciting career, he has had
the opportunity of working as a Trusted Talent Advisor with senior candidates and with a variety of
clients across sectors – large Indian Conglomerates, Blue Chip MNCs, Emerging Companies and
Mid-sized firms.

He is an Instrumentation Engineer from Bangalore University and has completed his MBA from XIM,
Bhubaneswar. He is certified in Personal Profile Analysis from Thomas International.

Outside work, he is a biker and loves to travel and watch movies.

×
Kunal Girap, Co-Founder & Director

With over two decades of experience, Kunal leads senior searches across multiple sectors and is a
trusted advisor to global business leaders in the Industry. He leads the Automotive, Aerospace &
Defense, Process & Infrastructure practices for the firm with teams spread across India & US. Kunal
is also architecting WalkWater’s digital journey and is passionate about technology and its impact
on the executive search process.

He has multifaceted background in Project Management, Industrial Sales & Marketing, Manufacturing
and Consulting that enables him to relate with candidates and clients across diverse sectors. Kunal
worked with Tyco International, Hindalco and ABC Consultants before Co-founding WalkWater.

A graduate in Mechanical Engineering and Executive Management Program from IIM Bangalore, Kunal is a
sports & fitness enthusiast and plays active club cricket in Mumbai. Kunal is a Rotarian and quite
passionate about giving it back to the society through the Rotary platform.

×
Harold D’Souza, Co-Founder & Director

Harold has worked in the Executive Search industry since 1998 , when the industry was still
developing into an important part of the corporate world. He has been part of the evolution of the
search industry and over the last two decades has contributed to its current stature and
positioning.

Before co-founding WalkWater, he was responsible for building the Technology Industry Practice in
India for Accord Group India and DHR International. Earlier experiences has been with E&Y and PSS.
His key expertise is building revenue and profit generating search businesses from scratch; and
developing long standing relationships with leaders, across industry sectors.

A special area of focus is Indian Business Houses and entrepreneur driven companies. Harold also
leads CEO and leadership searches, especially in Technology and related sectors. He also works
closely with many start-ups and founders.

Harold is a firm believer in the power of instinct in personal and professional life. He is also an
avid foodie, loves to cook and travel; and a keen squash player. He is also a non-fiction book lover
and owns a huge collection of books at his home in Bangalore.

×
Ashutosh Khanna, Co-Founder & Director

Ashu has more than 20 years of experience out of which he has spent 18+ years in the Executive
Search industry. Before co-founding WalkWater, Ashu led the Technology Practice at Korn/Ferry
FutureStep. During his career in the industry, he has successfully partnered with numerous
organisations on building their leadership team across India, US, Europe and South East Asia. He has
had the privilege to work with well-known Leaders of large firms (MNC/ Indian) as well as Founders
of Startup organizations across Technology and Consumer sectors.

With PGD in International Business from Symbiosis, Mechanical Engineering from Bangalore University
and Diploma in Consumer Protection Laws, Ashu is also certified in Competency based interviewing
from SHL and Right Management, Personality Profiling from Thomas International and Coaching Skills
by Results Coaching, Australia.

Besides work, he loves to read, play, travel and do long distance running.
